transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, hello. Um... I guess what scared me enough to actually come in today is that... I just keep thinking it would be a relief if I went to sleep and just didn't wake up. I haven't tried to hurt myself or do anything like that, but... just having that thought, it really scared me. So, that's why I'm here.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and feelings?
Well, it's been going on for about four months now. I'd say it really started right around the time my aunt came to live with us.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah, I have. Um... I used to really look forward to doing my watercolors, and going to my dance class. I liked walking with the ladies, too. But lately... I just leave my painting things sitting there on the table. I just can't seem to make myself care about any of it anymore.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or like you’re letting people down lately?

Yes, I have. Um... especially when it comes to my aunt. Sometimes I get really tired, or I find myself getting annoyed with her being here. And when I feel like that... well, I just start thinking I'm a bad woman. I feel like I'm bringing shame on my family for not being more grateful to have her around, you know? It just makes me feel like I'm really letting everyone down.
Do you feel this way most days, or are there days when you feel significantly better?

It's most days, honestly. Um... most mornings I just wake up with this heavy sadness right in my chest. It feels like I've already failed the day before it even starts. I don't really have days where I feel much better anymore.
Do you feel guilty or like you're not worth much nearly every day, or does it come and go?

It's pretty much every day. Like I said just a minute ago, it really happens whenever I get tired or annoyed with my aunt being here. And since she's around all the time... well, I end up thinking I'm a bad woman almost every single day. I just get overwhelmed with that feeling that I'm bringing shame on my family for not being more grateful. So, yeah, the guilt doesn't really come and go. It just stays with me.
